text:
Jordan: Hey all — dropping the company-level OKR draft for the upcoming quarter. Paste + comments below. Please flag any hard blockers or absolute no-gos by Thursday EOD so we can lock scope. link: https://docs.redwood.ai/okr/q3-draft

Tara: Thanks — quick read. Do we have customer asks baked into the high-priority buckets or still in backlog?

Jordan: Customer-driven asks are in the Growth bucket (see key result 1.2). We pulled the top 3 requests from enterprise accounts — logging, latency SLO, and private deployment docs.

Devin: From Eng POV latency SLO work will touch runtime and dedicated infra. Rough estimate = 2 eng months + 1 infra month if we reduce tail p99 by 20%. Any reprioritization guidance?

Leah: We should aim to keep one high-impact infra initiative in the quarter. If latency SLO is selected, we need to de-scope something else (probably the new analytics exporter).

Nina: Finance: customer asks tied to revenue can be accelerated, but we need clear launch criteria to justify bumping roadmap. What are success metrics for the latency work?

Jordan: Proposed KR for latency: "Reduce inference p99 for 8k token sequences by 20% for hosted API within quarter". Launch criteria: internal perf benchmark + canary with 5% traffic showing p99 improvement and no >1% error regression.

Sam: Question — can we do a staggered rollout to avoid full product freeze? Canary + automatic fallback to previous model/runtime on regression sounds fine. Also need feature flags for dedicated customers.

Devin: Agreed on flags. Also calling out risk: kernel selection changes might break quantized models. Need a compatibility matrix before canary.

Jordan: Good call. Action: Devin to propose compatibility checklist + estimated effort by Tue. Tara to confirm top 3 customer accounts that will join early canary.

Tara: Will confirm accounts. Also recommend pushing docs for Private deploy to next quarter if latency takes priority — docs are lower effort but require legal review.

Leah: If we push docs, allocate 0.5 PM for legal coordination next quarter rather than this one. That frees up PM cycles.

Nina: On revenue signal — if the three customers sign LOIs contingent on latency SLO, we can fast-track with reserved capacity billing. Please loop in account execs.

Jordan: Looping in okrs-bot to capture the decisions.

okrs-bot: Recorded decision: prioritize "Latency p99 reduction" as top infra KR for Q3 draft. Backfill: move "Private deploy docs" to Q4.

Sam: One more tradeoff — Optimize (cost/performance toolkit) enhancements were planned as a cross-functional bet. If we pick latency, we can scope Optimize MVP to "batching suggestions" only, postpone model quantization recommendations.

Devin: That scoping makes sense. We'll keep quant recommendations as a spike with no rollout.

Jordan: Final note on metrics: please add target baselines in the doc (current p99 numbers, billing impact estimate). I want all KRs to have measurable baselines by next sync.

Tara: Ack. I'll update doc and ping for review when done.

Leah: Thanks everyone. If no blockers by Thursday EOD, I'll mark the slate as "locked" and prep exec readout.
